slides.texte_overlay:
Things my dad taught me
without saying a word

1. He fixed things himself

I never saw him call
someone for a leaky tap.

2. He was always first up

The coffee was ready
before the house woke.

3. He showed up

Every game, every school play.
Tired or not.

4. He kept his body strong

Not for looks.
To carry us when we needed it.

5. He spoke well of my mother

In every room.
Even when she wasn't there.

6. He never stopped learning

A book on his nightstand,
always.
slides.texte_sophia:
6. He never stopped learning

I keep it going:
5 minutes a day on the Sophia app.
